# JaegerGRS.com

Independent IT and development portfolio by Jaeger G.R. Stratton.

**Live URL:** https://jaegergrs.com/
**Hosting:** Cloudflare Worker `jaegergrs-portfolio` (custom domains `jaegergrs.com`, `www.jaegergrs.com`), serving static assets.
**Source:** Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript generated by a dependency-free Node script.

## Structure

- `/` overview and live standalone sites
- `/projects/` index, with `svart-security/`, `grey-signal/`, `jaethetech/`, `jae/` and `hardware/`
- `/expertise/` with `hardware/` and `development/`
- `/about/` with `journey/`
- `/contact/`, `/changelog/`, `/404.html`

Each project page links out to the standalone site it describes (svartsecurity.org, jaethetech.com, the Grey Signal site, GitHub).

## Editing

`scripts/generate-pages.mjs` is the single source of truth for every HTML page and `sitemap.xml`. Edit it, then run:

```bash
node scripts/generate-pages.mjs   # regenerate pages
node scripts/check-site.mjs       # internal links, sitemap, CSP-unsafe inline styles/scripts
node scripts/build-site.mjs       # copy public files into dist/
node scripts/test-worker.mjs      # test the Worker headers, redirects and image serving
```

Commit the generated HTML; CI fails if it is out of date. External site URLs are constants at the top of the generator (for example `GREY` for Grey Signal, currently the raw IP over HTTP because no domain resolves yet).

## Deploy to Cloudflare

Cloudflare Pages Git integration returned `8000011` for this account, so production is a Worker deployed with Wrangler (`wrangler.toml`, assets from `dist/`).

1. Create a scoped API token with **Workers Scripts Edit**. Never commit it.
2. Add repository secrets `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.
3. Set the Actions variable `CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_ENABLED` to `true`.
4. Push to `main`; the workflow validates, builds and deploys.

Until step 3 is done, pushing to GitHub does not change the live site.

## Security

The Worker adds a strict CSP (no inline scripts or styles), HSTS, `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and redirects `www` to the apex.
